hooks.name: agentic-workflow-guard
hooks.description: Blocks the Jira write tools of the plugin's Atlassian server when the repository's write mode (or what the user accepted in setup) does not reach them.

hooks.name: agentic-workflow-alive
hooks.description: Leaves a marker for the session so that the start preflight can tell that hooks run (a workspace that is not trusted runs none).
